author: noelkimx
text: A read-only check that parses SQL can disagree with the database. In one MCP server (CVE-2026-61789), the check read -- as a comment even with no space after it. MySQL needs the space, so a DROP placed after 1--1 ran. An account granted only SELECT can't run that DROP anyway.

author: trvrio
text:
🚨 Turning off MPTCP does not fix the kernel bug. 

This is a common misconception I've seen after we published the article on @AtlasumNet.

Anthropic's root exploit for CVE-2026-98432 needed an MPTCP listener, but the bug is in plain IPv4 TCP. Turning off MPTCP blocks that

author: DrakonSystems
text: Ubuntu & RHEL still have no kernel fix for CVE-2026-98432 (critical Linux TCP bug, remote root). Mitigation: drop IPv4 TCP packets carrying IP options (nft, prerouting); net.mptcp.enabled=0.
